items.exampleEn: Athletic shoes are good for long walks.
The new gym near my office is open all night.
items.exampleZh: 我辦公室附近的新健身房整晚營業。

items.exampleEn: Thousands of spectators watched the final.
items.exampleZh: 數千名觀眾觀看了決賽。

items.exampleEn: We jogged along the beach on our holiday.
items.exampleZh: 我們度假時沿著海灘慢跑。

items.exampleEn: The referee made a bad decision in the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 裁判在最後一分鐘做了一個錯誤的判決。

items.exampleEn: The lifeguard told the kids to stay away from the deep water.
items.exampleZh: 救生員要孩子們遠離深水區。

items.exampleEn: She won the race by just one second.
items.exampleZh: 她只以一秒之差贏得比賽。

items.exampleEn: Nobody can beat my grandmother at chess.
items.exampleZh: 下西洋棋沒人贏得了我奶奶。

items.sentenceEn: The lifeguard watches the pool all day.
items.sentenceZh: 救生員整天看守游泳池。

items.audioEn: The city race starts at seven, so runners should arrive by half past six.
items.audioZh: 市區賽跑七點開始，所以跑者應該在六點半前到。

items.sentenceEn: The spectators stood up and cheered.
Do you want to jog with me tomorrow morning?
items.sentenceZh: 你明天早上想跟我一起慢跑嗎？

items.stemEn: I lift weights at the ____ after work.
items.stemZh: 我下班後在健身房舉重。

items.stemEn: Our team ____ the champions last night.
items.stemZh: 我們隊昨晚打敗了冠軍隊。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, our town holds a five-kilometer race in the park. Hundreds of runners take part, and many spectators come to cheer. My father is very athletic; he jogs every morning and goes to the gym twice a week. Last Saturday, he finally beat his best time. Next to the path, a lifeguard watches the lake. After the race, children play a short football game with a referee, and then there is a small outdoor concert.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，我們鎮上都會在公園舉辦五公里賽跑。有好幾百名跑者參加，也有很多觀眾來加油。我爸爸很擅長運動，他每天早上慢跑，每週去健身房兩次。上星期六，他終於打破了自己的最佳成績。步道旁有一位救生員看守湖邊。賽跑結束後，孩子們會由一位裁判帶著踢一場短短的足球賽，接著還有一場小型戶外音樂會。

referenceEn: The referee blew the whistle to start the game.
The referee started the match with his whistle.
rubricZh: 「吹哨子」可寫，例如 blow the whistle 等
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 gym 造一個句子，說說你去健身房的習慣或看法。
referenceEn: I go to the gym after work on Mondays.
I don't like the gym, so I exercise at home.
rubricZh: gym 表示「健身房」，例如 go to the gym 等說法
說的是自己的習慣或看法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
